newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber ends tad higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber ends tad higher on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly higher on Tuesday, as firmer overseas prices and the yen's retreat against the dollar stimulated moderate short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 1.1 yen per kg higher.
Benchmark October closed 0.5 yen higher at 139.8 yen.

"Moderate short-covering emerged from the outset. But prices shed some of their early gains as buying interest diminished after benchmark October came close to touching 141 yen per kg," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
